contradicting_evidence: ETH's relative resilience and positive recent taker imbalances could precede stabilization, although price follow-through is absent.
A majority of the observed constituents outperformed BTC over 24h, but this largely occurred within a declining market and is not broad absolute strength.
One settled ETF session and limited price observations cannot establish an uninterrupted multi-day decline.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: The balance favors continued pressure or an incomplete rebound followed by renewed weakness. Confidence is lower than at 12h because persistence across subsequent sessions is unverified. Stabilization alone would not establish continuation upward, and improved relative returns alone would not establish altcoin recovery.
falsification_conditions: BTC and ETH sustain recovery across subsequent sessions while breadth and median returns improve together.
Later settled ETF observations show improving demand alongside resilient prices, rather than an isolated positive flow reading.
Stablecoin contraction eases and observed participation broadens while ETH/BTC strength persists.
missing_evidence: Additional settled ETF sessions to distinguish persistent withdrawals from a single-session event.
Repeated breadth and ETH/BTC observations establishing durable improvement or contraction.
Updated liquidity, macro and catalyst information across the forecast window.
supporting_evidence: Stablecoin supply contracted approximately 0.36% over one day, 1.33% over seven days and 5.43% over 30 days; deployment confirmation is not established.
The latest final ETF session recorded BTC outflows of $306.5 million and ETH outflows of $39.8 million, an adverse demand backdrop rather than a forecast of subsequent flows.
Weak breadth and negative returns across all observed capitalization buckets provide no demonstrated broad recovery to offset the liquidity contraction.
Lagged macro levels, including a 5.1% ten-year yield and VIX of 25.46, are a cautious backdrop, though no current macro trend can be inferred.
